_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to portfolio.json and replace placeholder values with your actual book. Never commit your real portfolio.json (it's in .gitignore).
broker: <your broker, e.g., Danske Bank / Interactive Brokers>
account: <account name / type, e.g., taxable / OSK / ISA>
last_source: Brief note on how this snapshot was reconciled (broker screenshot, trade confirmation paste, etc.)

totals.realized_pnl_ytd_note: Sum of realized gains/losses YTD. Update from trades.log.jsonl.
totals.note: Free-text reconciliation notes go here. E.g., stale-price view vs live view, recent settlement events.

cash.components_note: How the cash position was derived. E.g., 'Post most-recent buy = settled cash €X − €Y deployed = €Z'.

holdings.name: Example AI-infra holding
holdings.history: Optional: brief lifecycle notes (initiated date, any trims/adds, realized P&L on partial exits).
holdings.thesis_flag_note: Optional: active thesis-break trigger status if any are partially hit.

holdings.name: Example event-trade position (pre-print catalyst)
holdings.next_catalyst: Q1 earnings YYYY-MM-DD AMC — binary event

concentration.note: Free-text concentration summary. Flag any cap breaches and rationale (deliberate catalyst trade vs unintentional drift).

earnings_wall.wk_X: Names printing in the next several weeks with €-exposure on each (binary risk highlight)
